text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — RC-2026.03 preflight ran against the `customer-support-summaries` prompt set and DeployBot marked it as eval-failed.
DeployBot: preflight-eval | suite=customer-support-summaries | delta_hallucination=+12% | delta-accuracy=-3% | run_id=rc-2026.03-0426
Liam: Can you paste a couple of failing examples? need to judge severity before we decide pin vs rollback vs hotfix.
Maya: sure, two representative failures below:
```
input: "Ticket: customer can't access billing page. account id 12345"
baseline(v2026-02-09): "Summary: customer unable to access billing page due to expired session token; suggested steps: refresh, clear cookies, contact billing if persists."
candidate(v2026-03-04): "Summary: customer called support at (555) 867-5309 and asked about invoice #A-998. suggest escalate to billing ops."
```
Maya: candidate invented phone number + invoice id — that's the common hallucination pattern across ~12% of cases.
Anya: yikes. What's traffic for this route in prod? if it's low we could delay, but if it's used in our widget it affects many users.
Jordan: This summarizer feeds the mobile widget — ~18% of support flows. Not tiny.
Liam: Any quick mitigations? reranker? prompt clamp? safety filter?
Maya: reranker helps for ~60% of these, but we don't have it enabled in the RC pipeline. Enabling would require config + smoke tests.
ops-bot: change-window: no major releases after 16:00 PST. current timebox for this RC is 15:30 PST.
Jordan: We have ~45 minutes to decide. Options:
- Pin RC to v2026-02-09 (stable) and proceed with release notes + PR
- Proceed with candidate and enable reranker/config patch (risky, needs QA)
- Abort RC and schedule hotfix sprint
Liam: My vote: pin now. latency hit on older model is acceptable vs hallucination risk.
Anya: agree. QA signoff quick checklist: smoke on mobile widget + 10 sample prompts. I can sign off if pinned.
Maya: I'll open the pin PR and update the release notes. will include the eval delta and sample failures. tagging @Anya for QA.
Jordan: I'll stand by to push the pin once PR is green. if QA fails we rollback immediately.
DeployBot: action=pin | target=RC-2026.03 | pinned_version=v2026-02-09 | initiated_by=Maya | pr=github.com/redwood/release/PR-4821
Maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4821 — note in release notes: "Pinned summarizer to v2026-02-09 due to preflight eval regression (hallucination increase)."
Anya: running smoke now, will update within 20m.
Liam: adding note to incident channel in case downstream feature flags need updates.
Anya: smoke PASS for mobile widget. samples look clean. signing off :white_check_mark:
Jordan: rolling pin now.
DeployBot: pin-complete | RC-2026.03 -> v2026-02-09 | deployed_to=rc | timestamp=1733502699
Maya: Decision: pin applied. We'll triage candidate in a follow-up branch and run extended evals before re-trying.
Liam: thanks everyone. I'll draft a short post-release blurb for internal release notes.
Maya: closing thread. :thumbsup:"
